caption: The drawing depicts a single, ankle-high shoe positioned in profile, facing left. The shoe is rendered in shades of grey, with a light brown trim outlining the top edge and a slightly darker brown sole. A pale, frayed ribbon or strap is attached near the opening of the shoe, hanging down along its side. The surface of the shoe is textured with fine, short lines indicating its material. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there are two unfinished sketches in plain outline showing the shoe from above and from the back, without any color or shading. The background is a uniform beige tone.
title: Carriage Boot
